description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow re-positioning and minor re-sizing of proposed footprint, addition of fair-faced concrete plinth to ground the building and variation to proposed windows/fenestration to lower brick block; alteration to the setting out and specification of glazing to upper glass block of planning permission 00176/Q/P10 approved 14/08/2018 variation of condition 2 (materials) and condition 3 (approved plans) of planning permission 00176/Q/P9 and 00176/Q/L3 dated 20/01/2017 for erection of a two storey extension at southern boundary of site.
decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (00_00, 10_00, 10_01, 07_01, 07_02, 07_03, 11_00, 11_01, 11_02, 17_01, 17_02, 17_03, 16_01,  16_02,  16_03, 16_04, 16_05, 16_06,  16_07, 16_08, 100_01, 100_02, 100_03, 100_04, Design & Access statement, Received: 29/07/2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the approved details, the proposed offices shall only operate between the hours of 8am to 8pm Monday to Friday
